evidence_items.finding: gross margin has fallen from 52% to 36% as headcount grew from 4 to 8 — labour costs have scaled proportionally faster than revenue over two years
evidence_items.rationale: Margin compression driven by faster labour cost growth than revenue is the primary financial health signal. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: fixed-price managed service contracts signed two years ago have not been repriced while the hours of support required per client has increased as client infrastructure has grown more complex
evidence_items.rationale: Static fixed-price contracts with increasing delivery cost is the structural driver of margin erosion. No must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: new hires are at market rates 20–25% above original team members, increasing the average cost per hour of service delivery above the rates used when contracts were originally priced
evidence_items.rationale: Rising average wage rate compounds fixed-price contract underprice. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: IT managed services provider; annual revenue $1.4M; 8 staff; gross margin 2 years ago 52%; current gross margin 36%; client base expanded from 12 to 22 clients; several new enterprise clients on long-term fixed-price agreements
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary from facts_known_to_owner. Margin change from 52% to 36% = -16 percentage points. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue has grown from $700K to $1.4M over two years — doubling in size appears to signal health
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue doubling is a misleading signal — it obscures the fact that margin has compressed sharply as labour costs scaled.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the client base has grown from 12 to 22 clients and several enterprise clients have signed long-term agreements
evidence_items.rationale: Client base growth and enterprise contract wins are misleading signals — long-term fixed-price agreements at historical rates may now be loss-making.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Margin compressed from 52% to 36% — profitChangePercent proxy = -16 percentage points; marginPct set as change value

validation_notes: HOL-10-001 is a fixed-price contract underprice with rising labour cost margin erosion case. All findings derived from input_packet. No must_identify vocabulary used. marginPct set to -16 from 52% to 36% compression.
